name: Amulet of the Planes

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Shift Planes
powers.text: Magic action: name a plane and make a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check; a success casts Plane Shift, a failure sends you and everyone within 15 ft somewhere random.

summary: Cast Plane Shift with a DC 15 Arcana check; a failure scatters you and those near you somewhere random.
text: While wearing this amulet, you can take a Magic action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you cast Plane Shift. On a failure, you and each creature and object within 15 feet of you travel to a random destination: a random location on the plane you named, or a random plane of existence. (The Mists of Barovia let nobody leave.)
